## The ladder of model changes

- Hyperparameter changes
- Adding a feature from the device profile
- Adding a versioned feature, such as a precomputed device embedding
- New feature shapes, such as moving from many-hot to sequence tensors
- New model frameworks, such as a DeepFM to DNN migration
